h1: Order questions answered by your chatbot
overview: Where is my order is the most common question in many shops. We connect an assistant to your store or shipping system so a customer can enter an order number and email and see the status and tracking link. It does not show other people's data. If your system cannot be read safely, we say so before you order and suggest another route.

faq: Which systems can it read orders from?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and many shipping tools such as ShipStation or carrier tracking pages. For custom systems we check what access exists before you order.
How do you stop people seeing someone else's order?
The assistant needs both the order number and the matching email before it shows anything. If they do not match, it shows a generic message and offers a person to contact.
Can the chatbot cancel or change an order?
Only requests, in our Premium package. The assistant records the request and sends it to your team or applies a rule you set. Refunds and edits stay under your control.
What if my store system is old or closed?
Some systems do not allow safe lookups. We tell you before you order. In those cases we can offer a version that explains the process and sends customers to a tracking page.
